mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 8% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 8.0% and remains below for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE remains below 8% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening household demand, reducing corporate revenue growth and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 new jobs per month signals robust labor market conditions, expanding corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by more than 150,000 for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS increases by more than 150,000 for 3 consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).
